intro: Football is Liberia's favourite sport, and its greatest player became president.

chapters.title: George Weah
text: George Weah won the Ballon d'Or in 1995, the only African to do so, and was Liberia's president from 2018 to 2024.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Kickball is popular, especially among girls.

keyTerms.meaning: The award for the world's best footballer.

items.text: Mighty Barrolle and Invincible Eleven are old giants.
